```yaml
name: Agent Board Integration

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every 15 minutes to check for new tasks
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_run:
        description: 'Force run even if no tasks are available'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      task_id:
        description: 'Specific task ID to process (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  repository-projects: write

jobs:
  agent-worker:
    name: Autonomous Agent Worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.repository == 'AndrewAltimit/template-repo' }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Build Agent CLI
        run: |
          cargo build --release --bin agent-cli
        env:
          CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

      - name: Query Board for Tasks
        id: query-board
        run: |
          # Use the agent CLI to query the GitHub Projects v2 board
          # This step uses the GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN for GraphQL API access
          echo "Querying board for unblocked TODO tasks..."
          
          # Check if specific task ID was provided
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.task_id }}" ]; then
            echo "Processing specific task: ${{ github.event.inputs.task_id }}"
            TASK_ID="${{ github.event.inputs.task_id }}"
          else
            # Query for unblocked TODO tasks
            TASK_ID=$(./target/release/agent-cli query-board \
              --board-id "${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_BOARD_ID }}" \
              --status "TODO" \
              --unblocked-only \
              --token "${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}" \
              --output json | jq -r '.tasks[0].id // empty')
          fi
          
          if [ -z "$TASK_ID" ]; then
            echo "No tasks found or specific task ID not provided."
            echo "has_task=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Found task: $TASK_ID"
            echo "has_task=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "task_id=$TASK_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Claim Task
        if: steps.query-board.outputs.has_task == 'true'
        id: claim-task
        run: |
          echo "Claiming task ${{ steps.query-board.outputs.task_id }}..."
          
          # Claim the task with agent session tracking
          CLAIM_RESULT=$(./target/release/agent-cli claim-task \
            --task-id "${{ steps.query-board.outputs.task_id }}" \
            --board-id "${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_BOARD_ID }}" \
            --agent-name "github-actions-agent" \
            --session-id "${{ github.run_id }}" \
            --token "${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}" \
            --output json)
          
          echo "$CLAIM_RESULT" | jq '.'
          
          # Extract claim status
          CLAIM_STATUS=$(echo "$CLAIM_RESULT" | jq -r '.status // "failed"')
          
          if [ "$CLAIM_STATUS" == "success" ]; then
            echo "claimed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            # Store task data in a file to avoid injection issues in env vars
            echo "$CLAIM_RESULT" > task_data.json
          else
            echo "claimed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Failed to claim task: $CLAIM_RESULT"
          fi

      - name: Execute Task
        if: steps.claim-task.outputs.claimed == 'true'
        id: execute-task
        run: |
          echo "Executing task..."
          
          # Parse task data from file
          TASK_TYPE=$(jq -r '.task_type // "unknown"' task_data.json)
          TASK_PROMPT=$(jq -r '.prompt // ""' task_data.json)
          TASK_CONTEXT=$(jq -r '.context // ""' task_data.json)
          
          echo "Task Type: $TASK_TYPE"
          echo "Task Prompt: $TASK_PROMPT"
          
          # Execute based on task type
          case $TASK_TYPE in
            "code-review")
              echo "Running code review task..."
              # Placeholder for code review logic
              RESULT="Code review completed"
              ;;
            "bug-fix")
              echo "Running bug fix task..."
              # Placeholder for bug fix logic
              RESULT="Bug fix completed"
              ;;
            "feature-implementation")
              echo "Running feature implementation task..."
              # Placeholder for feature implementation logic
              RESULT="Feature implementation completed"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "Unknown task type: $TASK_TYPE"
              RESULT="Task type not supported"
              ;;
          esac
          
          echo "execution_result=$RESULT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "execution_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Release Task
        if: always() && steps.claim-task.outputs.claimed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Releasing task ${{ steps.query-board.outputs.task_id }}..."
          
          # Determine final status based on execution
          if [ "${{ steps.execute-task.outputs.execution_status }}" == "success" ]; then
            FINAL_STATUS="DONE"
          else
            FINAL_STATUS="BLOCKED"
          fi
          
          # Release the task and update status
          ./target/release/agent-cli release-task \
            --task-id "${{ steps.query-board.outputs.task_id }}" \
            --board-id "${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_BOARD_ID }}" \
            --final-status "$FINAL_STATUS" \
            --session-id "${{ github.run_id }}" \
            --token "${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}" \
            --comment "Task processed by GitHub Actions Agent. Result: ${{ steps.execute-task.outputs.execution_result }}"

      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always() && steps.query-board.outputs.has_task == 'true'
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          channel: '#agent-updates'
          message: |
            Agent Board Integration Update:
            - Task ID: ${{ steps.query-board.outputs.task_id }}
            - Status: ${{ job.status }}
            - Result: ${{ steps.execute-task.outputs.execution_result || 'N/A' }}
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Upload Logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agent-logs-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            .agent-logs/
            !.agent-logs/*.tmp
          retention-days: 7
```
